name: The Sibling Experiment
source:
Even though their personalities vastly differ, Jasmine and TJ share the same sentiment: their brother is insufferable.

So when a cryptic ad pops up on their computer screens guaranteeing to switch their siblings with other people, Jasmine and TJ promptly sign up—only to find themselves waking up in total different lives one day!

How will they cope with their little dilemmas? What will they uncover about their siblings and themselves in this wild ride of upside down reality? Can they ever reverse the experiment and solve the mystery behind this life-changing experience (pun intended), and at what costs?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/568300/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
尽管性格截然不同，贾丝敏和TJ却有着同样的想法：他们的兄弟令人无法忍受。

于是，当电脑屏幕上弹出一则神秘广告，保证能把兄弟姐妹替换成其他人时，贾丝敏和TJ立刻报名参加——结果某天醒来，他们发现自己竟生活在完全不同的人生中！

他们要如何应对各自的小麻烦？在这场颠倒现实的狂奔中，他们会发现关于兄弟姐妹以及自己的什么秘密？他们能否逆转实验，解开这段改变人生经历背后的谜团（双关意味）？又要付出怎样的代价？

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/568300/]Steam[/url]）
